title: Parameterized Complexity of Scheduling Problems in Robotic Process Automation
summary: This paper studies the growing domain of Robotic Process Automation (RPA) problems. Motivated by scheduling problems arising in RPA, we study the parameterized complexity of the single-machine problem with precedence constraints, release times, and deadlines (i.e., the problem known as $1|\operatorname{prec},r_j,d_j|*$ in the three-field notation). We focus on parameters naturally linked to RPA systems, including chain-like precedences, the number of distinct processing times, and the structure of the time windows.
